text:
morgan: Quick heads-up — PR #7890 fixes a kv-cache warmup crash that's blocking today's RC. We need two reviewers to give explicit approvals before the 45m deploy window closes. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/7890

sam: on it, starting a pass now.

priya: I can review but I'm heads-down on another ticket for 20–30m. if someone else can give one quick eye it'd help.

alex: pinging @sam and @priya — can one of you confirm this doesn't regress async cache eviction? even a short note is fine.

morgan: short context: failure happens on warmup when concurrent init races; fix is a small mutex around the cache init. tests added. low risk but high-impact for users.

devops-bot: deploy window notice — release/rc-2026-03-17 scheduled to start in 45 minutes. Blockers: PR 7890 awaiting approvals.

maria: kicking CI rerun for the integration job (flaky last run): `./ci/run --job=integration --focus=kv-cache`

sam: found one flaky test, pushed a tiny timeout tweak and re-ran. left one inline question but not blocking. will approve after green.

priya: skimmed diff, looks good to me for a patch release. approving now — left a note about a telemetry tag we could add later.

sam: CI is green, approving now. lgtm :thumbsup:

morgan: great — two explicit approvals obtained. I'll merge at T-10 unless a blocker pops up. thanks for the quick turnaround.

deploy-bot: PR #7890 merged into release/rc-2026-03-17 by morgan. Deploy initiated.

morgan: tagging the release notes with "hotfix: kv-cache warmup race fix" and adding the telemetry follow-up to the backlog. Thanks everyone.
